charge_port.notes: "SAE Combo" DC fast charging, i.e. CCS1 (Wikipedia: CCS Combo 1 inlet, all years).

supercharger_access.notes: US: Hyundai (relayed by Motor.com) gives IONIQ Electric owners (bought by 2025-01-31) a complimentary CCS-to-NACS adapter.
Canada: Hyundai FAQ says Hyundai EVs of model year 2025 and earlier with a CCS port can use a NACS adapter sold separately (Ioniq Electric not named).
